name: molecule
definition: 由两个或两个以上原子通过化学键结合而成的、可作为整体独立存在的最小电中性粒子集合。 Counterexample: 原子：原子是化学变化中的最小微粒，是构成分子的更小单元；单个原子不构成分子。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table molecule; provenance: direct source molecule

name: atom
definition: 化学变化中不可再分的最小微粒，由原子核与核外电子构成，并以元素种类作为其区别特征。 Counterexample: 分子：分子由多个原子通过化学键结合而成，可再分为原子；原子不可再分为更小的化学微粒。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table atom; provenance: direct source atom

name: bond
definition: 分子内两个原子之间因电子作用而形成的、以键类型为区别特征的连接关系。 Counterexample: 原子：原子是参与成键的实体本身，而化学键是原子之间的连接关系，不是独立粒子。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table bond; provenance: direct source bond

name: connected
definition: 记录两个原子经由某一化学键相互连接这一事实的信息条目，以两端原子标识与键标识为区别特征。 Counterexample: 化学键：化学键是分子内原子间的实际连接关系，而本条目是描述该连接关系的信息记录，属于信息内容而非物理实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table connected; provenance: direct source connected

name: CarcinogenicLabel
definition: Molecule label indicating the molecule is carcinogenic.

name: NonCarcinogenicLabel
definition: Molecule label indicating the molecule is not carcinogenic.

name: HydrogenElement
definition: Atom whose element is hydrogen.

name: ChlorineElement
definition: Atom whose element is chlorine.

name: IodineElement
definition: Atom whose element is iodine.

name: SulfurElement
definition: Atom whose element is sulfur.

name: PhosphorusElement
definition: Atom whose element is phosphorus.

name: BromineElement
definition: Atom whose element is bromine.

name: FluorineElement
definition: Atom whose element is fluorine.

name: SingleBond
definition: Bond whose bond_type is single.

name: TripleBond
definition: Bond whose bond_type is triple.

name: BondType
definition: The type classification of a bond.

name: AtomElement
definition: The chemical element of an atom.

name: MoleculeLabel
definition: The carcinogenic classification label of a molecule.

name: BondAtom
definition: Atoms participating in a bond, recorded as atom_id and atom_id2.

name: CarcinogenicMoleculePercentage
definition: Percentage of all molecules that are carcinogenic. Formula: COUNT(CarcinogenicLabel) / COUNT(MoleculeLabel) * 100. Inputs: CarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '+'; MoleculeLabel = molecule.label
aliases: percentage of molecules that are carcinogenic

name: NonCarcinogenicMoleculePercentage
definition: Percentage of all molecules that are non-carcinogenic. Formula: COUNT(NonCarcinogenicLabel) / COUNT(MoleculeLabel) * 100. Inputs: NonCarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '-'; MoleculeLabel = molecule.label

name: ChlorinePercentageInCarcinogenicMolecules
definition: Percentage of atoms in carcinogenic molecules that are chlorine. Formula: COUNT(ChlorineElement) / COUNT(AtomElement) * 100. Inputs: ChlorineElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'cl'; AtomElement = atom.element; CarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '+'
aliases: percentage of chlorine in carcinogenic molecules

name: HydrogenRatioInMolecule
definition: Ratio of hydrogen atoms to all atoms in a given molecule. Formula: COUNT(HydrogenElement) / COUNT(AtomElement). Inputs: HydrogenElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'h'; AtomElement = atom.element
aliases: ratio of hydrogen elements in molecule

name: SingleBondCarcinogenicProportion
definition: Percentage of single bonds that belong to carcinogenic molecules. Formula: COUNT(CarcinogenicLabel) / COUNT(SingleBond) * 100. Inputs: CarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '+'; SingleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '-'
aliases: proportion of single bonds that are carcinogenic

name: AverageBondsPerIodineAtom
definition: Average number of bonds associated with atoms that are iodine. Formula: COUNT(BondAtom) / COUNT(IodineElement). Inputs: BondAtom = connected.atom_id; IodineElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'i'
aliases: average number of bonds the atoms with iodine have

name: CarcinogenicMoleculesWithoutFluorinePercentage
definition: Percentage of carcinogenic molecules that do not contain any fluorine atom. Formula: (COUNT(CarcinogenicLabel) - COUNT(FluorineElement)) / COUNT(CarcinogenicLabel) * 100. Inputs: CarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '+'; FluorineElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'f'
aliases: percentage of carcinogenic molecules that do not contain flu

name: MostNumerousLabelInHydrogenAtoms
definition: The molecule label that appears most frequently among atoms with hydrogen. Formula: MODE(MoleculeLabel) WHERE HydrogenElement. Inputs: MoleculeLabel = molecule.label; HydrogenElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'h'
aliases: most numerous label in atoms with hydrogen
label most numerous in hydrogen atoms
most numerous label in hydrogen atoms

name: LeastNumerousElementInNonCarcinogenicMolecules
definition: The element that appears least frequently among atoms in non-carcinogenic molecules. Formula: MIN(COUNT(AtomElement)) WHERE NonCarcinogenicLabel. Inputs: AtomElement = atom.element; NonCarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '-'
aliases: least numerous element in non-carcinogenic molecules
least numerous element in non carcinogenic molecules

name: MostCommonBondType
definition: The bond type that occurs most frequently. Formula: MODE(BondType). Inputs: BondType = bond.bond_type

name: TotalAtomsInTripleBondMoleculesWithPhosphorusOrBromine
definition: Total number of atoms in molecules that have triple bonds and contain phosphorus or bromine. Formula: COUNT(AtomElement) WHERE TripleBond AND (PhosphorusElement OR BromineElement). Inputs: AtomElement = atom.element; TripleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '#'; PhosphorusElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'p'; BromineElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'br'
aliases: total atoms with triple-bond molecules containing phosphorus
atoms in triple bond with P or Br
total atoms in triple bond molecules with phosphorus or bromine

name: CountAtomsWithIodineAndSulfurInSingleBondMolecules
definition: Count of distinct atoms that are iodine or sulfur in molecules with single bonds. Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT IodineElement) + COUNT(DISTINCT SulfurElement) WHERE SingleBond. Inputs: IodineElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'i'; SulfurElement = atom.element WHERE element = 's'; SingleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '-'
aliases: how many atoms with iodine and sulfur in single bond molecul
iodine and sulfur atoms in single bonds
count atoms with iodine and sulfur in single bond molecules

name: Carcinogenicity
definition: Analysis of molecules classified as carcinogenic or non-carcinogenic based on their label.

name: ChemicalElements
definition: Analysis of atoms by their chemical element, including hydrogen, chlorine, iodine, sulfur, phosphorus, bromine, fluorine, and others.

name: BondTypes
definition: Analysis of bonds by their type, such as single, double, or triple bonds.
